videos.title: Apple Watch Heart Rate: Morgan’s True Apple Watch Story
videos.description:
After receiving multiple high heart rate alerts on her Apple Watch, Morgan sought medical care. Doctors identified a kidney infection that had escalated into septic shock, a potentially life threatening condition she was treated for immediately. She credits the notifications with helping save her life.

Learn more about Apple Watch heart rate notifications at https://apple.co/3W2Gfh7

videos.title: The new MacBook Pro with M6 delivers blazing-fast performance and up to 24 hours of battery life.
videos.description:
The new MacBook Pro with M6 delivers blazing-fast performance and the longest battery life ever in a Mac — up to 24 hours. M6 joins M5 Pro and M5 Max to create Apple’s most advanced lineup of pro laptop chips. Featuring a Liquid Retina XDR display with 1600 nits of peak HDR brightness, a 12MP Center Stage camera, and a studio-quality three-mic array. And when you need power fast, it can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes.

Pre-order the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starting at 10:10 a.m.
